title: Caring for Orphans and the Reward
summary: Caring for orphans leads to proximity with the Prophet in Paradise.
translation: In the society we live in, it is our responsibility to arrange for the welfare of the poor, orphans, and helpless people of that society. If everyone feels and realizes this responsibility and endeavors to implement it practically, then believe me, there won't be any society or community where the needy have to extend their hands elsewhere or express their needs before others. This is why the Messenger of the Lord of the Worlds, the Holy Prophet (peace be upon him), has given very high glad tidings for supporting the helpless and looking after orphans. There is a hadith of Hazrat Sahl ibn Sa'd (may Allah be pleased with him) in which the Holy Prophet (peace be upon him) stated that 'I and the person who looks after an orphan will be in Paradise like this.' And he (peace be upon him) showed the gap between his index and middle fingers, saying, 'Look, like this.' Then he joined them and said, 'The one who looks after an orphan will be so close to me.' This indicates that in Paradise, the closeness between me and the one who raises an orphan will be like the distance between these two fingers. Some scholars of hadith say that the slight gap shown between the fingers indicates that the rank of prophethood is close to the generous person. The generous one is very beloved to Allah Almighty. Thus, it becomes evident that supporting orphans, arranging for them, and becoming their support is a very good deed, and effort should be made to practice it.
